# contract: tests/fixtures/land_witness/

Immutable native launch fixtures, copied to persistent scratch before tests.

## Allowed

| Pattern | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `contracts.md` | This contract |
| `provenance.json` | Original archive/member/hash/size identities |
| `adc-zero-margin.json` | Thirteen exact ADC witness records on the immutable adc subject |
| `base/**` | Native-clean complete-class public/oracle triples |
| `hostile/**` | Hostile complete-class public/oracle triples |
| `matrix/**` | Base/hostile eighteen-station triples and frozen cases.json UUIDs |
| `native-controls/**` | Ten PAD/FP/custom/board clearance precedence triples |
| `semantics-controls/**` | Six Boolean/string/area control triples |
| `focused/**` | Three below-board-width/one-IU-area control triples |
| `adc/**` | Exact approved immutable board/project/rules for retained ADC coordinates |

Only the named JSON and .kicad_pcb/.kicad_pro/.kicad_dru triples belong in
these fixture directories. Generated reports/logs remain in persistent
TMPDIR. Audit with t1_land_witness.py and contracts_audit.py. Behavioral
properties and exact native UUID coverage are graded; generated bytes are
not goldens. Public base is 2 graded/5 copper/3 floorless; native base is
0 findings/0 opens, hostile specified track is two exact clearance pairs/0
opens. Full hostile policy is independently checked in native batches below
report limits. Nominal inventories establish no connectivity or release claim.
